---- MODULE etcd_raft ----
EXTENDS etcd_raftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL AR_BagLib == INSTANCE BagsTheorems
LOCAL AR_FiniteLib == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

LEMMA AR_FiniteBridge ==
    \A s : /\ IsFiniteSet(s) = AR_FiniteLib!IsFiniteSet(s)
           /\ Cardinality(s) = AR_FiniteLib!Cardinality(s)
    BY DEF IsFiniteSet, AR_FiniteLib!IsFiniteSet,
           Cardinality, AR_FiniteLib!Cardinality

LEMMA AR_BagBridge ==
    \A x, y : /\ IsABag(x) = AR_BagLib!IsABag(x)
              /\ (x (-) y) = AR_BagLib!(-)(x, y)
    BY DEF IsABag, AR_BagLib!IsABag, (-), AR_BagLib!(-)

LEMMA AR_BagDifference ==
    \A x, y : IsABag(x) /\ IsABag(y) =>
        /\ IsABag(x (-) y)
        /\ DOMAIN (x (-) y) =
            {e \in DOMAIN x : e \notin DOMAIN y \/ x[e] > y[e]}
    BY SMTT("r2"), AR_BagLib!Bags_Difference, AR_BagBridge

LEMMA AR_PendingBag ==
    IsABag(pendingMessages) => \A i : IsABag(PendingMessages(i))
    BY SMTT("r2") DEF IsABag, PendingMessages


\* Election certificates include volatile votes, persisted votes, replies
\* in transit, and votes already collected by a candidate or leader.
AR_InitialConfig == [jointConfig |-> <<InitServer, {}>>, learners |-> {}]

AR_Active(i) == state[i] \in {Candidate, Leader}

AR_LiveVote(v, t, c) ==
    /\ t <= currentTerm[v]
    /\ t = currentTerm[v] => votedFor[v] = c

AR_DurableVote(v, t, c) ==
    /\ t <= durableState[v].currentTerm
    /\ t = durableState[v].currentTerm => durableState[v].votedFor = c

AR_Granted(m) == m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse /\ m.mvoteGranted

AR_MessageType(m) ==
    /\ m.msource \in Server
    /\ m.mdest \in Server
    /\ m.mterm \in Nat
    /\ m.mtype \in {RequestVoteRequest, RequestVoteResponse,
                    AppendEntriesRequest, AppendEntriesResponse}

AR_Types ==
    /\ IsABag(messages)
    /\ IsABag(pendingMessages)
    /\ currentTerm \in [Server -> Nat]
    /\ state \in [Server -> {Follower, Candidate, Leader}]
    /\ votedFor \in [Server -> Server \cup {Nil}]
    /\ votesGranted \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
    /\ DOMAIN durableState = Server
    /\ durableState = [i \in Server |-> durableState[i]]
    /\ config = [i \in Server |-> AR_InitialConfig]
    /\ \A i \in Server :
        /\ durableState[i].currentTerm \in Nat
        /\ durableState[i].votedFor \in Server \cup {Nil}
        /\ durableState[i].config = AR_InitialConfig

AR_Stable ==
    \A i \in Server :
        /\ durableState[i].currentTerm <= currentTerm[i]
        /\ /\ durableState[i].currentTerm = currentTerm[i]
           /\ durableState[i].votedFor # Nil
           => votedFor[i] = durableState[i].votedFor

AR_Candidates ==
    \A i \in Server : AR_Active(i) =>
        /\ currentTerm[i] > 0
        /\ votedFor[i] = i
        /\ \A v \in votesGranted[i] : AR_DurableVote(v, currentTerm[i], i)

AR_LeaderCertificate ==
    \A i \in Server : state[i] = Leader =>
        \E Q \in Quorum(InitServer) : Q \subseteq votesGranted[i]

AR_Messages ==
    \A m \in DOMAIN messages :
        /\ AR_MessageType(m)
        /\ m.mterm <= durableState[m.msource].currentTerm
        /\ AR_Granted(m) => AR_DurableVote(m.msource, m.mterm, m.mdest)

AR_Pending ==
    \A m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages :
        /\ AR_MessageType(m)
        /\ m.mterm <= currentTerm[m.msource]
        /\ AR_Granted(m) => AR_LiveVote(m.msource, m.mterm, m.mdest)

AR_Core ==
    /\ AR_Types
    /\ AR_Stable
    /\ AR_Candidates
    /\ AR_LeaderCertificate
    /\ AR_Messages
    /\ AR_Pending

AR_Vote(v, t, c) ==
    \/ /\ currentTerm[v] = t
       /\ votedFor[v] = c
    \/ /\ durableState[v].currentTerm = t
       /\ durableState[v].votedFor = c
    \/ \E m \in DOMAIN messages \cup DOMAIN pendingMessages :
        /\ AR_Granted(m)
        /\ m.msource = v
        /\ m.mterm = t
        /\ m.mdest = c
    \/ /\ AR_Active(c)
       /\ currentTerm[c] = t
       /\ v \in votesGranted[c]

AR_UniqueVotes ==
    \A v, c, d \in Server : \A t \in Nat :
        AR_Vote(v, t, c) /\ AR_Vote(v, t, d) => c = d

AR_ElectionInv == AR_Core /\ AR_UniqueVotes


LEMMA AR_SingletonBag == \A m : IsABag(SetToBag({m}))
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF IsABag, SetToBag

LEMMA AR_WithMessageFacts ==
    \A m, b : IsABag(b) =>
        /\ IsABag(WithMessage(m,b))
        /\ DOMAIN WithMessage(m,b) = DOMAIN b \cup {m}
    BY SMTT("r2") DEF IsABag, WithMessage, SetToBag, (+)

LEMMA AR_WithoutMessageFacts ==
    \A m, b : IsABag(b) =>
        /\ IsABag(WithoutMessage(m,b))
        /\ DOMAIN WithoutMessage(m,b) \subseteq DOMAIN b
    BY SMTT("r2"), AR_BagDifference, AR_SingletonBag DEF WithoutMessage

LEMMA AR_ClearedPendingFacts ==
    IsABag(pendingMessages) => \A i :
        /\ IsABag(ClearPendingMessages(i))
        /\ DOMAIN ClearPendingMessages(i) =
             {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i}
    BY SMTT("r3"), AR_BagDifference, AR_PendingBag
       DEF ClearPendingMessages, PendingMessages, IsABag

LEMMA AR_ReleasedPendingFacts ==
    IsABag(pendingMessages) /\ IsABag(messages) => \A i :
        /\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i) (+) messages)
        /\ DOMAIN (PendingMessages(i) (+) messages) =
             DOMAIN messages \cup {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i}
    BY SMTT("r3") DEF IsABag, PendingMessages, (+)

LEMMA AR_VoteBound ==
    AR_Core =>
        \A v, c \in Server : \A t \in Nat :
            AR_Vote(v, t, c) => AR_LiveVote(v, t, c)
    BY SMTT("r10"), NilNotServer
       DEF AR_Core, AR_Types, AR_Stable, AR_Candidates,
           AR_Messages, AR_Pending, AR_MessageType,
           AR_Vote, AR_Granted, AR_LiveVote, AR_DurableVote

LEMMA AR_InitElection == Init => AR_ElectionInv
    BY SMTT("r10"), DistinctRoles, NilNotServer
       DEF Init, InitMessageVars, InitServerVars, InitCandidateVars,
           InitLeaderVars, InitLogVars, InitConfigVars, InitDurableState,
           AR_ElectionInv, AR_Core, AR_Types, IsABag, AR_InitialConfig,
           AR_Stable, AR_Candidates, AR_Active, AR_LeaderCertificate,
           AR_Messages, AR_Pending, AR_UniqueVotes, AR_Vote,
           EmptyBag, SetToBag

LEMMA AR_SubsetVotes ==
    ASSUME AR_UniqueVotes,
           \A v, c \in Server : \A t \in Nat :
               AR_Vote(v, t, c)' => AR_Vote(v, t, c)
    PROVE AR_UniqueVotes'
    BY SMTT("r2") DEF AR_UniqueVotes

LEMMA AR_FewerMessagesElection ==
    ASSUME AR_ElectionInv,
           IsABag(messages'), DOMAIN messages' \subseteq DOMAIN messages,
           UNCHANGED <<pendingMessages, currentTerm, state, votedFor,
                        votesGranted, config, durableState>>
    PROVE AR_ElectionInv'
<1>1. AR_Core'
    BY SMTT("r5")
       DEF AR_ElectionInv, AR_Core, AR_Types, AR_Stable, AR_Candidates,
           AR_Active, AR_LeaderCertificate, AR_Messages, AR_Pending,
           AR_MessageType, AR_Granted, AR_LiveVote, AR_DurableVote
<1>2. \A v,c \in Server : \A t \in Nat : AR_Vote(v,t,c)' => AR_Vote(v,t,c)
    BY SMTT("r2") DEF AR_Vote, AR_Granted, AR_Active
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AR_SubsetVotes DEF AR_ElectionInv

           RequestVote, GetConfig, GetJointConfig, GetLearners, AR_InitialConfig, Send, SendDirect, Reply, ReplyDirect, Discard, DiscardDirect, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
<1>2. \A v, c \in Server : \A t \in Nat :

           RequestVote, GetConfig, GetJointConfig, GetLearners, AR_InitialConfig, Send, SendDirect, Reply, ReplyDirect, Discard, DiscardDirect, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars

<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>3 DEF AR_ElectionInv

    \A Q, R \in Quorum(InitServer) : \E v \in Server : v \in Q \cap R
<1>1. ASSUME NEW Q \in Quorum(InitServer), NEW R \in Quorum(InitServer)
      PROVE \E v \in Server : v \in Q \cap R
    <2>1. /\ IsFiniteSet(Q) /\ IsFiniteSet(R)
          /\ Cardinality(Q) \in Nat /\ Cardinality(R) \in Nat
          /\ Cardinality(InitServer) \in Nat
        BY SMTT("r3"), <1>1, AR_FiniteLib!FS_Subset, AR_FiniteLib!FS_CardinalityType, FiniteServers, AR_FiniteBridge DEF Quorum
    <2>2. /\ Q \subseteq InitServer /\ R \subseteq InitServer
          /\ Cardinality(Q)+Cardinality(R) > Cardinality(InitServer)
        BY SMTT("r1"), <1>1, <2>1 DEF Quorum
    <2>3. /\ AR_FiniteLib!IsFiniteSet(InitServer)
          /\ AR_FiniteLib!Cardinality(Q) + AR_FiniteLib!Cardinality(R)
                > AR_FiniteLib!Cardinality(InitServer)
        BY SMTT("r1"), <2>2, FiniteServers, AR_FiniteBridge
    <2>4. Q \cap R # {}
        BY <2>2, <2>3, AR_FiniteLib!FS_MajoritiesIntersect
    <2> QED BY SMTT("r1"), <1>1, <2>4, InitServerSubset DEF Quorum
<1> QED BY <1>1

    <2>3. PICK v \in Server : v \in Q \cap R
